completion_scope: Frozen NS005 curation checkpoint with all16 unchanged public baselines actually qualified. This correction preserves population, splits, source pins, acceptance definitions, original receipts and failure history. No final hidden oracle or model repair was run.

criteria.criterion: Every task has a fixed pre-fix snapshot, expected baseline condition, independent acceptance criteria, provenance, and split assignment.
criteria.explanation: All16 frozen historical cases retain the exact pre-fix source, acceptance definitions and split. Fresh isolated unchanged-baseline runs produced4,685 actual passed tests and187 explicitly non-passing upstream skips. The twelve previously nonempty cases use their exact original visible node IDs; the four empty historical collections now use default unchanged upstream pre-fix discovery. Actual collection/execution identities match and every original source/test file hash is unchanged. Empty, all-skipped, failed, collection-error, teardown-error and incomplete executions cannot qualify. Prior hidden-oracle applicability is preserved as historical evidence; no hidden oracle was read or rerun in this correction.

criteria.criterion: Deduplication covers near-duplicate families, prior fixtures, related-paper corpora, and patch/acceptance leakage.
criteria.explanation: One live task per upstream lineage; SWE-bench twelve families, CVE-identified commits, and Lean/autoformalization material were excluded from the roster. The 40 sch-bench fixtures are listed only as preliminary_fixture_only. tasks.jsonl contains no reference patches or FAIL_TO_PASS payloads; hidden payloads are hash-pinned reconstruction recipes under scorer_only/ with payload_stored_in_tree=false and proposal_sandbox_may_mount_hidden_store=false. Shared-org clustering is disclosed, not silently merged.

criteria.criterion: Invalid/valid paired cases cover all retained Table 18 boundaries and Table 12 mutation categories.
criteria.explanation: Retained Table 18 boundaries (provider, translation, fixture lifecycle, restart publication) each have valid_progress and safe_rejection overlays bound to every frozen final family (64 cases at 8 final families). All 29 retained Table 12 mutation categories have valid/invalid pairs on independently generated nsq_fixture_v1 (58 cases), distinct from the old 40 fixtures. Native/world Table 18 rows remain narrowed and are holdout-only.

criteria.criterion: Population size and exclusions are fixed before final outcomes; no favorable-case selection is permitted.
criteria.explanation: An a-priori roster was SHA-256 ranked before verification. Eligibility (license, Python-only bounded patch, tests, executed fail-to-pass) was applied in rank order. Verification failures were excluded with reasons and were not replaced after freeze. Actual live N=16 versus the preregistered 24 is recorded as a shortfall requiring a versioned NS-016 amendment; unused quota is not filled from easier leftovers. replacement_after_freeze=false.

limitations: Actual recruited live families are 16, below the preregistered 24. NS-016 must issue a versioned pre-final amendment or treat missing families as missing scheduled units; this freeze does not silently relabel the design.
No provider invocation or live historical repair result was produced. Builder pytest runs establish oracle applicability only.
Compact snapshot recipes pin admitted repair-surface files by commit and SHA-256; they are not full upstream worktrees. NS-006 materializes the pinned pre-fix commit for execution.
Hidden oracle payloads are hash-pinned reconstruction recipes and are not stored in the proposal-visible tree.
Shared-org libraries remain disclosed; independence is not assumed for population promotion.
All16 unchanged-baseline qualifications are newly executed; historical hidden-oracle applicability was retained but not independently rerun here.
187 upstream dnspython skips are not passed tests or qualified optional capabilities. No row, family or scheduled unit was excluded.

The independent_scorer_principal marker in historical curation metadata is a requirement, not proof of runtime isolation. NS026 and NS016 must qualify actual provider/source-store/scorer boundaries before real comparisons.
Synthetic negative admission controls are not benchmark observations.

baseline_correction.qualification_kind: actual unchanged tests plus synthetic admission controls; no paid providers
